functions.name: PutbackOrValidateCharWithCodecvt
functions.summary: Validates a character (a2) for putback or output against an encoding-table length tracked via the pointer at this+0x1C. On the table-matching putback path it bumps the reference count and returns the character (or 0 for the end sentinel). Otherwise, when an output device is present at this+0x50, it either validates a backward buffer scan and truncates the stream (copying this+0x3C into this+0x40) or writes the raw byte through FileIOWrapperWithLock. Returns the character on success and -1 on failure.

operations.description: Reads v3 as the value at offset 0 of the structure pointed to by this+0x1C; interpreted as the encoding-table length/size used by the putback validation.
Enters the encoding-table path only when v3 is non-zero and the putback state value at offset 0 of the pointer at this+0xC is below v3.
Matches the putback when a2 equals -1 (end sentinel) or when the byte at v3 - 1 (last table position) equals a2.
Calls RefCountIncDec(this) on the matched putback path, adjusting the object's reference state.
Returns a2 when it is not -1, otherwise returns 0; the putback of the matched character or the end-sentinel sentinel value.
Output path requires a non-null output device at this+0x50 and a character (v4) that is not -1.
When the stream buffer pointer at this+0x38 is set, dereference the buffer pointer stored at this+0x44 and read its capacity v7 at offset 8.
Proceeds with the backward scan only when the buffer capacity v7 is non-zero.
Calls BufferBoundaryMarkerCheckSet on the stream buffer pointer stored at this+0x44 before scanning.

Runs CharByCharBackwardScanWithValidation over the buffered data (start at offset 4 of the stream buffer), the output device at this+0x50 and the capacity v7; the character is considered present when it returns non-zero.
Calls BufferTruncationShrink(0, -1) to shrink the stream buffer after the backward validation succeeds.
Copies the position/state value at this+0x3C into this+0x40, updating stream position tracking after the successful backward validation.
Returns a2 when the backward validation path consumed the character from the buffered stream.
When no buffered scan applies, writes the raw byte v4 to the output device at this+0x50 via FileIOWrapperWithLock and returns v4 when the write does not fail.
Returns -1 when none of the putback or output paths accept the character.

functions.name: CallbackChainIteration
functions.summary: Iterates a singly-linked callback list whose head is stored at this+0x1C. For each node, invokes the function pointer at node offset 0x8 as a __cdecl callback with arguments (a2, this, node_userdata), where node_userdata is at node offset 0x4. Advances via the next pointer at node offset 0x0. Returns the result of the last callback executed.

operations.description: Initialize the loop cursor i from the list head stored at this+0x1C.
for-loop over the singly-linked callback list; continues while the current node pointer is non-null and advances i through the next pointer at node offset 0x0.
Invoke the callback function pointer at node offset 0x8 as __cdecl(a2, this, node_userdata), passing the user data at node offset 0x4; store its return value as result.
Return the result of the last callback invoked (result of the final list node, or an indeterminate value if the list was empty).
Invoked by sub_59A980 (0x0059A980) to run this callback chain.
